paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Friday (the 18th) that he plans to personally receive Chinese President Xi Jinping at the airport when Xi arrives in the Washington area next week, and that their meeting will produce “a number of different agreements.” He described U.S.–China relations as “going very well” and expects a “very good meeting.”

Xi Jinping is scheduled to visit Washington next week and to hold talks with Trump on September 24. Trump plans to meet him at Joint Base Andrews outside Washington, D.C., a rare occasion for a sitting U.S. president to greet a foreign leader at the airport.
Speaking to reporters in the Oval Office, Trump said, “President Xi and I have a great relationship. We will reach a number of different agreements here… we will have a very good meeting.”
Trump added that the United States and China “get along very well,” and referenced the tariffs the U.S. has imposed on Chinese goods.
He said, “China is paying us a lot of tariffs.” Trump noted that the tariff rate had once reached 145%, that he later lowered it, and that the 145% rate “really hit them hard.”

A senior U.S. official told reporters that Xi’s trip will include a visit to the White House, with a arrival ceremony on the White House grounds, a military review on the Rose Garden, and an evening state dinner.

The official said the dinner guests will include several tech CEOs: Amazon founder Jeff Bezos, Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai, OpenAI chief Sam Altman, Apple CEO Tim Cook, Tesla CEO Elon Musk, NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang, and Dell Technologies CEO Michael Dell.
The official said the two sides are expected to discuss trade, the global supply of rare‑earth elements, and topics such as artificial intelligence.
Trump said it was a pity that the White House’s banquet hall is not yet open; otherwise he could have hosted a dinner for about 2,000 guests during Xi’s U.S. visit.

Trump on U.S.–China espionage: When asked about concerns over China’s treatment of journalists, he replied, “I don’t know. I think we also suppress, we have fake news. We don’t suppress, but they write fake news.”

Trump also said both countries are engaged in spying on each other. He explained, “People say, ‘Oh, they’re watching us.’ I say, ‘Maybe they are, but we’re watching them too.’” He added that he would not disclose classified information.
The White House released the schedule for the planned Trump‑Xi meeting:

September 23, Wednesday – Xi and his wife Peng Liyuan arrive at Joint Base Andrews outside Washington, D.C. Trump will greet Xi at the airport and both will take part in an arrival ceremony. It is unusual for a U.S. president to personally receive a foreign leader at a military‑base airport.
September 24, Thursday – Trump and Xi hold talks during the day and attend the state dinner in the evening.

Trump will receive Xi and Peng Liyuan at the White House. They will go to the Rose Garden for a military review, followed by bilateral talks. First Lady Melania Trump and Peng Liyuan will attend a separate event in the Washington area; details have not been released. In the evening, Trump and his wife will host a state dinner for Xi and Peng Liyuan in the East Room, with speeches at the start and a guest list that includes many senior tech and finance executives.

September 25, Friday – Tea, visits and departure. The Trumps will have tea with Xi and Peng Liyuan at the White House, then both parties will visit the National Archives in Washington to view founding‑era documents. Xi and Peng Liyuan will return to Joint Base Andrews and then depart.

items.title: Netflix遭降評跌近5% 用戶參與度「令人擔憂」
items.title_en: Netflix Downgrades and Shares Fall Nearly 5% as User Engagement Raises Concerns
paras: 《Investopedia》報導，Netflix(NFLX-US)近期股價受到打擊，一批分析師認為，這家串流影音巨頭的股價可能還會進一步下跌。
Netflix股價周五(18日)下跌近5%，收在略低於72美元，延續近期跌勢。此前富國銀行(Wells Fargo)分析師下調Netflix股票評級，使其成為標普500指數與那斯達克指數中跌幅較大個股之一。
富國銀行將Netflix股票評級由中立下調至「減碼」，並將目標價從80美元大砍至57美元，創華爾街最低目標價，遠低於市場共識的97美元。
在Visible Alpha追蹤的另外14名分析師中，有12人給予Netflix股票買進評級，另有2人給予中立評級。
富國銀行在周五發布給客戶的報告指出，Netflix近期的用戶參與度趨勢「令人擔憂」。該行指出，今年上半年Netflix每位訂閱戶每日的觀看時間，較2023年同期下降8%。分析師寫道，「Netflix缺乏大型原創影集，這點已經開始顯現。」
富國銀行認為，Netflix可能需要進行一次「內容支出重整」，並警告公司若持續拓展遊戲等不同類型的娛樂內容，可能因此面臨「錯過能引發大眾討論的原創作品」的風險。
近幾個月來，市場對Netflix營收成長放緩的擔憂持續拖累股價。隨著周五股價下挫，Netflix今年以來股價已經下跌近25%。
paras_en: Investopedia reports that Netflix (NFLX-US) has recently seen its stock price hit a snag, with a group of analysts suggesting that the streaming giant’s shares could continue to decline.

Netflix’s stock fell nearly 5% on Friday (18th), closing just below $72, extending its recent downward trend. Earlier, Wells Fargo analysts downgraded Netflix, making it one of the biggest losers in both the S&P 500 and Nasdaq indices.
Wells Fargo lowered Netflix’s rating from neutral to ‘underperform’ and slashed its target price from $80 to $57, setting a new Wall Street low that is far below the market consensus of $97.
Among the 14 analysts tracked by Visible Alpha, 12 gave Netflix a buy rating while two maintained a neutral stance.

In a Friday report to clients, Wells Fargo noted that Netflix’s recent user‑engagement trend is “concerning.” The bank pointed out that in the first half of this year, the average daily viewing time per subscriber fell 8% compared to the same period in 2023, and analysts wrote that “Netflix’s lack of large‑scale original series is already becoming apparent.”

Wells Fargo believes Netflix may need a “content spend re‑allocation” and cautions that the company could face the risk of “missing out on original works that spark public discussion” if it continues to expand into games and other entertainment formats.
Over the past few months, market worries about Netflix’s slowing revenue growth have continued to drag the stock. With Friday’s price drop, Netflix’s shares have fallen nearly 25% year‑to‑date.

items.title: 美股震盪收高半導體支撐盤面、油價與美債殖利率壓抑買氣
items.title_en: US Stocks Rally on Semiconductor Support, Oil Prices and U.S. Treasury Yields Damp Buying
paras: 2026年09月19日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美股18日結束震盪的一週，標普500與那斯達克指數小幅收高，半導體股走強提供支撐，但美國公債殖利率突破5%，加上原油價格維持每桶100美元以上，使通膨與利率前景持續壓抑市場情緒。
標普500指數上漲0.17%至7,650.50點，那斯達克指數上漲0.40%至26,522.55點，道瓊工業指數則下跌0.18%至51,682.64點。標普500全週小幅收低，那斯達克周線上漲，道瓊則創3月以來最大單週跌幅。
市場焦點集中在聯準會升息後的利率路徑。投資人一方面評估升息對股票與固定收益資產的影響，另一方面仍須面對能源價格帶來的通膨壓力。根據CME FedWatch，市場預期聯準會10月再次升息的機率已升至55.4%，高於前一週的42.5%，一個月前更僅7.2%。
原油價格盤中回吐部分漲幅，但收盤仍高於每桶100美元。中國應沙烏地阿拉伯要求，敦促伊朗限制葉門胡塞武裝對沙國石油基礎設施的攻擊，使油價暫時降溫。不過，柴油價格已升至歷史高點，農業與運輸成本可能進一步承受壓力。
全球央行也持續因應伊朗戰爭帶來的通膨壓力。日本央行將利率升至31年高點，跟進聯準會與歐洲央行升息；英國央行則維持利率不變，但警告未來仍可能升息。
類股方面，標普500科技股表現最佳，公用事業跌幅最大。加密貨幣相關股票則隨比特幣上漲5.9%走強，Coinbase(COIN-US)、Strategy(MSTR-US)及Robinhood(HOOD-US)分別上漲9.1%至16.4%。
個股方面，波克夏海瑟威Berkshire Hathaway(BRK.B-US)宣布華倫．巴菲特將卸下董事長職務，轉任榮譽董事長，距離他將執行長職位交棒給Greg Abel約9個月，股價當日小幅走低。
Xenon Pharmaceuticals(XENE-US)則重挫30.7%，公司因出現副作用通報，暫停實驗性重度憂鬱症與雙相情緒障礙藥物的臨床試驗受試者招募。

paras_en: On September 19, 2026, U.S. stocks ended a volatile week with the S&P 500 and Nasdaq indices posting modest gains, buoyed by a rally in semiconductor shares. However, U.S. Treasury yields surpassed 5%, and oil prices stayed above $100 per barrel, keeping inflation and interest‑rate expectations weighing on market sentiment.

The S&P 500 rose 0.17% to 7,650.50, the Nasdaq climbed 0.40% to 26,522.55, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 0.18% to 51,682.64. Over the week, the S&P 500 edged lower, the Nasdaq gained, and the Dow recorded its largest single‑week decline since March.

Investors focused on the path of rates after the Fed’s rate hike, weighing the impact on equities and fixed‑income assets while still confronting inflationary pressure from energy prices. According to CME FedWatch, the market’s probability of another Fed hike in October rose to 55.4%, up from 42.5% the previous week and 7.2% a month ago.

Oil prices retraced some intraday gains but closed above $100 per barrel. China, at Saudi Arabia’s request, urged Iran to limit Houthi attacks on Saudi oil infrastructure, temporarily cooling oil prices. Nevertheless, diesel prices hit historic highs, potentially adding pressure to agricultural and transportation costs.

Global central banks continued to respond to inflationary pressure from the Iran war. The Bank of Japan lifted rates to a 31‑year high, following the Fed and ECB, while the Bank of England left rates unchanged but warned that further hikes could come.

Sectorally, technology stocks in the S&P 500 performed best, while utilities saw the largest decline. Cryptocurrency‑related stocks strengthened as Bitcoin rose 5.9%, with Coinbase (COIN-US), Strategy (MSTR-US), and Robinhood (HOOD-US) gaining 9.1% to 16.4% respectively.

In individual stocks, Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.B-US) announced that Warren Buffett would step down as chairman and become honorary chairman, about nine months before handing the CEO role to Greg Abel, causing the stock to dip slightly that day.
Xenon Pharmaceuticals (XENE-US) plunged 30.7% after reporting adverse events, suspending recruitment for its experimental drugs for severe depression and bipolar disorder.

items.title: 亞馬遜、Palantir等14檔科技股獲瑞銀首選！AI支出仍處早期
items.title_en: Amazon, Palantir and 12 Other Tech Stocks Named UBS Picks; AI Spending Still in Early Stage
paras: 《MarketWatch》報導，瑞銀(UBS)分析師認為，人工智慧支出周期仍處於早期階段，這為投資人在科技、媒體與電信(TMT)產業中帶來多項值得關注的機會。
瑞銀團隊近期公布14檔「最有信心推薦股」，其中許多公司都受惠於AI，以及整體AI生態系仍有大量資金流入的趨勢。
在AI成長方面，分析師表示，「下一階段的成長應該來自企業採用」。瑞銀在周四給客戶的報告指出，在他們調查的企業中，目前僅8%已大規模部署AI代理。瑞銀團隊也預期，隨著企業整合供應商並削減IT預算，AI基礎設施支出將會增加。
儘管開源AI模型因成本優勢而逐漸受青睞，瑞銀分析師指出，企業往往仍會透過微軟(MSFT-US)Azure及亞馬遜(AMZN-US)Amazon Web Services(AWS)等雲端平台部署這些模型。
亞馬遜是瑞銀在大型網路公司的首選股。由於瑞銀對AWS營收的預估高於市場共識，分析師認為，隨著亞馬遜的大型客戶準備在今年稍晚至2027年期間部署其Trainium 2與Trainium 3晶片，華爾街「應該會跟上」市場對亞馬遜的預期。
瑞銀給予亞馬遜的目標價為318美元，較目前股價高出約25%。
在晶片與半導體設備公司中，瑞銀的首選是類比晶片製造商德州儀器(TXN-US)。
分析師指出，類比晶片周期正在回升，而這個市場主要受到汽車與工業需求驅動，且德州儀器近年也持續提高市占率。
隨著產業動能增強，以及資料中心熱潮為公司創造更多成長機會，分析師認為，德州儀器有望進一步擴大市占，並加速自由現金流成長。
瑞銀分析師表示，「即使明年資料中心業務的成長略微放緩，德州儀器的總營收仍有望成長約20%。」瑞銀團隊認為，德州儀器股價仍有43%的上漲空間，目標價為380美元。
在電信與網路設備領域，瑞銀認為Celestica(CLS-US)將受惠於OpenAI明年推出首款自研晶片。分析師預期，這將支撐Celestica營收至少70%的成長。瑞銀指出，Celestica目前已是超大規模雲端業者的主要乙太網路交換技術供應商，客戶包括Alphabet旗下Google及Meta Platforms。
瑞銀分析師估計Celestica股價仍有29%上漲空間，目標價為430美元。
瑞銀表示，資料中心建設熱潮也將為全球IT通路商TD Synnex(TSNX-US)帶來助益，因該公司是大型雲端服務供應商的製造合作夥伴。
分析師指出，TD Synnex旗下Hyve Solutions業務，主要提供資料中心所需的客製化硬體，包括伺服器與網路設備，將受惠於市場對更快運算與網路傳輸能力不斷增加的需求。瑞銀團隊預估，未來3年資料中心基礎設施的資本支出將以每年至少30%的速度成長。
分析師預計，TD Synnex股價可上漲32%至352美元。
同時，瑞銀認為Palantir Technologies(PLTR-US)「正處於軟體產業兩大最強勁支出趨勢——AI與資料——的交會點」。
瑞銀團隊預期，Palantir營收將成長88%，利潤率則可達60%出頭，因此認為Palantir股價「非常具吸引力」。
Palantir目前股價約為177.64美元，瑞銀給予的目標價為250美元。
此外，瑞銀團隊表示，Palantir的AI與自動化軟體需求背景非常強勁，而且來自其他AI與軟體供應商的競爭有限。

瑞銀團隊在TMT產業的其他首選股還包括SS&C Technologies(SSNC-US)、AT&T(T-US)、EchoStar(SATS-US)、Pinterest(PINS-US)、Spotify Technology(SPOT-US)、Mastercard(MA-US)、Global-e Online(GLBE-US)、Procore Technologies(PCOR-US)及JFrog(FROG-US)。
paras_en: MarketWatch reports that UBS analysts believe the AI spending cycle is still in its early stage, creating multiple noteworthy opportunities for investors in the technology, media and telecommunications (TMT) sector.
UBS recently released a list of 14 "most confident recommendation" stocks, many of which benefit from AI and from the continued large inflows of capital into the broader AI ecosystem.

Regarding AI growth, analysts say "the next phase of growth should come from enterprise adoption." In a Thursday client note, UBS noted that only 8% of the companies they surveyed have deployed AI agents at scale, and they expect AI infrastructure spending to rise as firms consolidate vendors and trim IT budgets.

Although open‑source AI models are gaining favor for their cost advantage, UBS analysts point out that enterprises still tend to run these models on cloud platforms such as Microsoft (MSFT-US) Azure and Amazon (AMZN-US) Web Services (AWS).

Amazon is UBS's top pick among large‑network companies. Because UBS forecasts AWS revenue above market consensus, analysts think Wall Street will catch up to expectations for Amazon as its major customers prepare to deploy Trainium 2 and Trainium 3 chips later this year through 2027.
UBS assigns Amazon a target price of $318, roughly 25% above the current share price.
Among chip and semiconductor‑equipment firms, UBS's top pick is analog‑chip maker Texas Instruments (TXN-US).
Analysts note that the analog‑chip cycle is reviving, driven mainly by automotive and industrial demand, and that Texas Instruments has been steadily increasing its market share in recent years.

With industry momentum strengthening and the data‑center boom creating additional growth avenues, analysts believe Texas Instruments is poised to further expand its share and accelerate free‑cash‑flow growth.

UBS analysts say "even if data‑center growth slows slightly next year, Texas Instruments' total revenue should still rise about 20%." The team sees a 43% upside potential for the stock, with a target price of $380.

In the telecom and networking‑equipment space, UBS expects Celestica (CLS-US) to benefit from OpenAI's first self‑developed chip slated for launch next year, which should support at least 70% revenue growth for Celestica. UBS notes that Celestica already supplies Ethernet‑switching technology to hyperscale cloud providers, including Google (Alphabet) and Meta Platforms.
UBS estimates Celestica's share price still has a 29% upside, setting a target of $430.
UBS says the data‑center construction boom will also aid global IT distributor TD Synnex (TSNX-US), as the company is a manufacturing partner for large cloud service providers.

Analysts highlight that TD Synnex's Hyve Solutions unit, which provides custom hardware for data centers such as servers and networking gear, will benefit from rising demand for faster compute and network‑transfer capabilities. UBS projects data‑center infrastructure capital spending to grow at least 30% per year over the next three years.
Analysts forecast TD Synnex's stock could rise 32% to $352.
At the same time, UBS views Palantir Technologies (PLTR-US) as being "at the intersection of the two strongest spending trends in software—AI and data."
The UBS team expects Palantir's revenue to grow 88% and its profit margin to exceed 60%, making the stock "very attractive."
Palantir is currently trading around $177.64, and UBS assigns it a target price of $250.
Additionally, UBS says the demand backdrop for Palantir's AI and automation software is extremely strong, with limited competition from other AI and software vendors.

Other UBS top picks in the TMT sector include SS&C Technologies (SSNC-US), AT&T (T-US), EchoStar (SATS-US), Pinterest (PINS-US), Spotify Technology (SPOT-US), Mastercard (MA-US), Global‑e Online (GLBE-US), Procore Technologies (PCOR-US) and JFrog (FROG-US).

items.title: 不只美國赤字堪憂！法國為何成為歐陸下一枚金融未爆彈？
items.title_en: Not Just the U.S. Deficit to Worry About! Why France Is the Next Potential Financial Time Bomb in Europe?
paras: 如果你擔心美國公債殖利率飆升，別忘了看看法國：這個歐陸第二大經濟體今夏的借貸成本一度超越義大利與希臘，而投資人關注的關鍵指標——法國與德國公債殖利率間的利差——正持續擴大，朝1個百分點的心理關卡邁進。
Natixis投資管理公司全球市場策略主管Mabrouk Chetouane說：「市場的容忍度可能已經達到某個門檻。」
法國面臨的問題並不難理解，目前的預算赤字相當於國內生產毛額(GDP)的5%，而且至少到明年4月總統大選前，財政整頓的可能性都相當低。
法國總統馬克宏(Emmanuel Macron)卸任在即，他手中握有降低財政壓力的最大一張牌，是將退休年齡從62歲提高至64歲，但由於他所屬政黨已經失去國會的控制權，這項改革已遭暫緩。在2027年民調中領先的雷朋(Marine Le Pen)則希望把退休年齡降至60歲，同時大砍燃料與電力稅。
倫敦大學瑪麗王后學院國際經濟學教授Brigitte Granville指出，法國目前用於償債的支出已超過公共教育支出，「情況正變得愈來愈難以持續」。

稅負沉重、外資持債比重高

在政治僵局下，除了與美國同樣都面臨失控的財政赤字，法國還要處理其他難題。Granville指出，法國稅收占GDP比重已達43.5%，是已開發國家中最高的一批。相形之下，美國約為25%。
Natixis的Chetouane表示，外國投資人持有法國主權債券的比重達57%，這提高了投資人集體撤出的風險。相較下，美國公債的外資持有比重約為40%。
此外，法國今年經濟成長率最多只有0.5%，美國則維持約2%的成長。
法國與美國的共同點，在於兩國經濟規模都太大，無法承受倒下所帶來的災難性後果，而這種情境幾乎沒有人願意想像。Granville說：「如果他們讓法國倒下，歐元就會崩潰，」

ECB成最後防線

因此，市場目光開始轉向歐洲央行(ECB)，以及尚未真正接受考驗的「傳導保護工具」(Transmission Protection Instrument，TPI)。TPI旨在授權ECB購買成員國公債，以「抵禦不合理且失序的市場動態」。
Chetouane說，「這有點像是避免重演2012年的核武級解決方案」，指的是希臘債務違約後，南歐各國公債殖利率大幅飆升的情況。
他預測，若法國公債與德國公債利差接近1.5個百分點，就到達可能啟動TPI的程度。
不過，如果明年的選舉能產生一個有效運作的多數政府，法國仍可能重新整頓局面。
美國企業研究院(AEI)國際總體經濟學資深研究員Steven Kamin說：「法國目前的利差仍遠低於2010年代危機期間義大利或西班牙的水準。」
與雷朋都屬於歐洲極右翼陣營的義大利總理梅洛尼(Giorgia Meloni)，過去四年已樹立一個正面例子。她在維持政治支持度的同時，將義大利財政赤字從GDP的7%降至3%，而且成為該國自二戰以來任期最長的政府領導人。

法國公債殖利率4.5%可能成買點

Natixis的Chetouane表示，法國10年期主權公債殖利率若升至4.5%，也就是比目前水準再高幾個基點，可能成為實際的「進場點」。不過，他強調，這只是謹慎試水溫，而不是押上全部資金。
Chetouane表示，隨著總統大選後還會舉行國會選舉，法國注定還要經歷約一年的政治擺盪。雷朋雖然已放棄早先退出歐盟與歐元區的主張，但她承諾大幅削減各項繳款及推動其他改革，可能對本已脆弱的歐洲大陸經濟構成挑戰。
paras_en: If you are worried about soaring U.S. Treasury yields, don’t forget to look at France: the continent’s second‑largest economy saw its borrowing costs this summer briefly surpass those of Italy and Greece, and the key metric investors watch—the yield spread between French and German government bonds—is widening, moving toward the psychological barrier of one percentage point.
Natixis Investment Management’s global markets strategist Mabrouk Chetouane said, “The market’s tolerance may have already hit a certain threshold.”

France’s problems are easy to understand: the current budget deficit is about 5% of GDP, and at least until the presidential election in April next year the likelihood of fiscal consolidation remains low.

President Emmanuel Macron is about to leave office, and his biggest lever to ease fiscal pressure is raising the retirement age from 62 to 64, but the reform has been stalled because his party has lost control of parliament. In 2027 polls, Marine Le Pen, who is ahead, wants to lower the retirement age to 60 and slash fuel and electricity taxes.

Queen Mary University of London professor of international economics Brigitte Granville noted that France now spends more on debt service than on public education, “the situation is becoming increasingly unsustainable.”

Heavy tax burden, high foreign‑bond holdings
Amid the political deadlock, France faces not only an out‑of‑control fiscal deficit like the United States, but also other challenges. Granville points out that taxes account for 43.5% of France’s GDP, one of the highest ratios among developed nations, compared with roughly 25% in the U.S.
Chetouane of Natixis said foreign investors hold 57% of French sovereign bonds, raising the risk of a collective pull‑out. By contrast, foreign holdings of U.S. Treasuries are about 40%.
Moreover, France’s economic growth this year is projected at a maximum of 0.5%, while the United States maintains around 2% growth.

France and the United States share the fact that both economies are so large that a collapse would have catastrophic consequences, a scenario few can imagine. Granville warned, “If they let France fall, the euro would collapse.”

ECB as the final backstop
Consequently, market attention has shifted to the European Central Bank (ECB) and the still‑untested “Transmission Protection Instrument” (TPI). The TPI would authorize the ECB to buy member‑state bonds to “counter unreasonable and disorderly market dynamics.”
Chetouane said, “It’s a bit like avoiding a repeat of the 2012 nuclear‑option solution,” referring to the sharp surge in Southern European bond yields after Greece’s debt default.
He predicts that if the French‑German yield spread reaches about 1.5 percentage points, the conditions could trigger the activation of the TPI.
However, if next year’s election produces an effectively functioning majority government, France could still re‑establish fiscal order.

Steven Kamin, senior researcher in international macroeconomics at the American Enterprise Institute, said, “France’s current spread is still far below the levels Italy or Spain saw during the 2010s crisis.”

Italy’s prime minister Giorgia Meloni, who sits in the European far‑right camp alongside Le Pen, has set a positive example over the past four years. While maintaining political support, she cut Italy’s fiscal deficit from 7% of GDP to 3% and became the longest‑serving post‑World‑War‑II leader in the country.

Natixis’s Chetouane said that if France’s 10‑year sovereign yield rises to 4.5%—a few basis points above current levels—it could become a practical “entry point.” He stressed, however, that this would be a cautious test of the waters, not an all‑in bet.

Chetouane added that with a parliamentary election to follow the presidential vote, France is destined to endure about a year of political turbulence. Although Le Pen has dropped her earlier calls to leave the EU and eurozone, she promises deep cuts to contributions and other reforms that could challenge an already fragile European economy.

items.title: 超級央行週掀升息潮！Fed、日銀同步升息 英國按兵不動卻轉鷹
items.title_en: Super Central Bank Week Sparks Rate Hikes
paras: 全球金融市場本週迎來「超級央行週」，美國聯準會 (Fed)、英國央行與日本央行 (BOJ) 在不到 48 小時內接連公布利率決策。面對能源價格上漲與通膨壓力升溫，Fed 與日本央行同步升息，英國央行雖然按兵不動，政策立場也明顯轉趨鷹派，顯示全球主要央行正重新加強對通膨風險的防範。
Fed 週三以 12 比 0 一致通過升息 1 碼，將聯邦資金利率目標區間調高至 3.75%至 4%，為 2023 年 7 月以來首次升息。Fed 表示，通膨仍處於高檔，這次政策行動將有助於通膨更及時地回到 2%目標。
Fed 最新經濟預測顯示，18 名決策官員中有 16 人預估，今年底利率至少將較目前水準高出 1 碼，意味多數官員預期今年可能再次升息。主席華許表示，通膨過高且持續時間過長，夏季公布的數據也未顯示潛在通膨趨勢已出現實質改善，Fed 將持續以恢復物價穩定為政策重點。
英國央行週四以 6 比 3 決議維持基準利率在 3.75%不變，但表決結果顯示內部對升息的支持正在增加。包括首席經濟學家皮爾 (Huw Pill) 在內的 3 名官員主張升息 1 碼至 4%，以降低能源價格上漲進一步推升國內通膨的風險。
英國央行警告，中東衝突推升全球能源價格，可能使英國通膨在 2027 年初突破 4%。央行總裁貝利 (Andrew Bailey) 表示，能源價格前景仍高度不確定，央行必須密切觀察成本上升是否進一步擴散至薪資與其他價格。
日本央行週五則以 7 比 2 通過升息 1 碼，將政策利率由 1%調高至 1.25%，創下1995年以來、31年最高水準，也代表日本貨幣政策進一步擺脫長期超寬鬆立場。
日本央行總裁植田和男表示，央行政策重心正由推升通膨，轉向預防通膨持續超越 2%目標。隨著潛在通膨接近 2%，企業也持續將工資及原料等成本上升反映在售價，日本央行因而需要提前防範通膨超標風險。
不過，日本央行升息後，日元兌美元反而貶至兩週低點，貶破157價位，回測157.141。市場認為，升息幅度已提前反映，加上 2 名決策官員投下反對票，日本央行也未提供明確的後續升息時程，使投資人對其持續緊縮的力道抱持疑慮。
本週決策顯示，能源價格與地緣政治風險已重新推高全球通膨疑慮。
Fed 與日本央行正式升息，英國央行雖維持利率不變，內部已有 3 名官員支持升息；加上歐洲央行上週已將存款利率調高至 2.5%，主要央行整體政策基調正轉趨緊縮。
市場接下來將關注能源價格走勢，以及燃料成本上升是否進一步擴散至薪資、服務與企業定價。若第二輪通膨效應逐漸浮現，主要央行可能採取更多緊縮措施，全球利率維持高檔的時間也可能進一步拉長。
paras_en: This week the global financial markets witnessed a "Super Central Bank Week," as the U.S. Federal Reserve (Fed), the Bank of England, and the Bank of Japan (BOJ) announced rate decisions within a span of less than 48 hours. Facing rising energy prices and intensifying inflationary pressures, the Fed and BOJ moved to raise rates simultaneously, while the Bank of England stayed flat but shifted its stance toward hawkishness, indicating that major central banks are once again tightening to guard against inflation risks.

On Wednesday, the Fed voted 12‑to‑0 to raise rates by 1 basis point, lifting the federal funds target range to 3.75%‑4%, the first hike since July 2023. The Fed said inflation remains high, and this policy action will help bring inflation back to the 2% target more promptly.

The Fed’s latest economic projections show that 16 of 18 policymakers expect rates to be at least 1 basis point higher than current levels by year‑end, implying that most officials anticipate another hike this year. Chair Jerome Powell said inflation is too high and too persistent, and that summer data have not shown a substantial improvement in underlying inflation trends, so the Fed will continue to focus on restoring price stability.

On Thursday, the Bank of England voted 6‑to‑3 to keep the base rate at 3.75%, but the vote revealed growing support for a rate increase. Three officials, including chief economist Huw Pill, advocated a 1‑basis‑point hike to 4% to reduce the risk of energy‑price‑driven domestic inflation.

The Bank of England warned that the Middle‑East conflict is pushing global energy prices higher, potentially pushing UK inflation above 4% in early 2027. Governor Andrew Bailey said the energy‑price outlook remains highly uncertain and the bank must closely monitor whether cost pressures spread further into wages and other prices.

On Friday, the BOJ voted 7‑to‑2 to raise rates by 1 basis point, lifting the policy rate from 1% to 1.25%, the highest level since 1995 and the 31st‑year high, marking a further move away from its long‑term ultra‑accommodative stance.

BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda said the policy focus is shifting from pushing inflation up to preventing inflation from staying above the 2% target. As core inflation approaches 2%, firms are continuously passing higher wage and raw‑material costs onto prices, so the BOJ must pre‑emptively guard against inflation overshooting.

However, after the BOJ hike, the yen fell to a two‑week low against the dollar, breaking the 157 level and testing 157.141. Markets believe the hike’s magnitude was already priced in, and with two policymakers voting against, the BOJ did not provide a clear timetable for further tightening, raising doubts about its continued tightening strength.
This week’s decisions show that energy prices and geopolitical risks have once again pushed global inflation concerns higher.

The Fed and BOJ formally raised rates, the Bank of England kept rates unchanged but with three officials supporting a hike, and the European Central Bank last week lifted its deposit rate to 2.5%; overall, major central banks are adopting a more restrictive stance.

Markets will now focus on energy‑price trends and whether rising fuel costs spread further into wages, services, and corporate pricing. If a second‑round inflation effect emerges, major central banks may take additional tightening steps, potentially extending the period of high global rates.

items.title_en: Micron Labor Negotiations Cover Three Issues; Second Meeting Scheduled for Oct. 22
paras: 美光(MU-US)台灣與台灣美光記憶體工會於昨日舉行首次調解會議，美光今(19)日表示，雙方進行有建設性且助於推進溝通的討論，並同意於 10 月 22 日舉行第二次調解會議。雙方感謝中部科學園區管理局(CTSP)及調解委員會在本次調解過程中所提供的協助與支持。
美光勞資雙方在此次會議中，就多項議題進行討論，包括整體獎酬與獎金制度架構、禁搭便車(No Free Rider)議題，以及禁止秋後算賬(Non-Retaliation)等。
有關最後一項，美光再次重申公司的承諾，正如《美光全球團隊成員手冊》中所載明，團隊成員有權在不必擔心遭受報復的情況下，和平集會、自由結社、成立及加入其自行選擇的工會或勞工組織，並尋求集體協商或其他形式的代表權。
雙方將持續秉持相互尊重的精神，透過正向、務實的溝通，支持員工、服務客戶，並共同促進公司的持續成功。
paras_en: Micron (MU-US) and the Taiwan Micron Memory Workers Union held their first mediation meeting in Taiwan yesterday. Micron announced on the 19th that the discussion was constructive and helped advance communication, and both parties agreed to hold a second mediation meeting on October 22. The parties thanked the Central Taiwan Science Park Administration (CTSP) and the mediation committee for their assistance and support during the process.
During the meeting, Micron and the union discussed several matters, including the overall compensation and bonus structure, the No Free Rider issue, and the prohibition of non‑retaliation practices.

Regarding the last item, Micron reiterated its commitment, as stated in the Micron Global Team Member Handbook, that team members have the right to peacefully assemble, freely associate, form and join unions or labor organizations of their choosing, and seek collective bargaining or other forms of representation without fear of retaliation.

Both sides will continue to uphold a spirit of mutual respect, engage in positive and pragmatic communication, support employees and serve customers, and jointly promote the company’s ongoing success.

items.title: 黃仁勳駁斥AI末日論 「2030年人類滅絕機率為0%」
items.title_en: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang Denies AI Doomsday Claims, Asserts 2030 Human Extinction Probability Is 0%
paras: 輝達執行長黃仁勳接受CBS News專訪時，駁斥人工智慧 (AI) 將在2030年導致人類滅絕的說法，直言這類末日警告毫無根據，並認為部分人士可能出於政治、博取關注或其他目的散播恐懼。
黃仁勳稱，AI應「盡可能快速」發展，但企業絕不能在產品尚未成熟或不安全時推出。
當被問到是否同意美國總統川普，將AI可能毀滅人類的憂慮稱為「騙局」？黃仁勳稱，他完全不認同AI將在2030年導致人類滅絕的說法。
黃仁勳指出，由 AI 開發者宣揚世界末日論並在全美製造恐慌，令他難以理解。他認為，這些人可能另有目的，包括政治考量、吸引外界關注，或爭取媒體曝光。
黃仁勳表示，無論外界如何描述 AI 風險，2030年都不會成為世界末日，發生這種情況的機率為「0%」。
輝達執行長黃仁勳反對業界協調放慢 AI 開發，認為安全與發展速度並非二選一，企業可以在加速創新的同時，確保產品符合安全要求。
黃仁勳近日頻頻發表對AI產業的看法。
他15日在Salesforce年度Dreamforce大會上表示，AI產業不需要新增法律或監管，他認為，企業本身已有商業及法律誘因，會在確認產品安全且具實用性後才推向市場，因此不需要政府另設新的監管制度。
他主張，要求AI產業在創新速度與安全之間二選一，是錯誤的命題，各家公司應依自身技術與產品狀況決定開發速度，而非要求整個產業同步放慢。
黃仁勳認為，業者本身已有確保產品安全及實用性的商業誘因。
黃仁勳也認同川普反對以安全疑慮阻礙AI及資料中心發展的立場。川普先前將部分AI安全警告稱為「騙局」，黃仁勳則回應，美國不會讓相關阻力妨礙AI基建。
黃仁勳警告，過度監管可能阻礙美國仍在發展的開源AI生態。對輝達而言，多元且相互競爭的模型開發商不僅能維持市場需求，也可為美國提供抗衡中國開源模型的選擇。
paras_en: During a CBS News interview, NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang dismissed the claim that artificial intelligence (AI) would cause human extinction in 2030, stating that such doomsday warnings are unfounded and that some individuals may spread fear for political, attention-seeking, or other motives.
Huang said AI should develop as quickly as possible, but companies must never release products that are immature or unsafe.

When asked whether he agreed with former U.S. President Trump’s labeling of concerns that AI could destroy humanity as a "hoax," Huang replied that he completely disagrees with the notion that AI will lead to human extinction in 2030.

Huang pointed out that AI developers who promote doomsday scenarios and create panic across the United States are difficult for him to understand, suggesting they may have ulterior motives such as political considerations, attracting external attention, or seeking media exposure.
He stated that regardless of how the outside world describes AI risks, 2030 will not be the end of the world, and the probability of such an event is "0%."

Huang opposed industry-wide coordination to slow AI development, arguing that safety and speed are not mutually exclusive and that companies can accelerate innovation while ensuring products meet safety requirements.
He has been frequently expressing his views on the AI industry recently.

On the 15th at Salesforce’s annual Dreamforce conference, he said the AI industry does not need new laws or regulations, believing that companies already have commercial and legal incentives to bring products to market only after confirming safety and practicality, so new regulatory frameworks are unnecessary.

He argued that the premise of forcing the AI industry to choose between innovation speed and safety is wrong, and that each company should determine its development pace based on its own technology and product situation rather than requiring the entire industry to slow down together.
Huang believes that businesses already have commercial incentives to ensure product safety and practicality.

He also agreed with Trump’s stance against using safety concerns to hinder AI and data center development. Trump had previously called some AI safety warnings a "hoax," and Huang responded that the United States will not let such resistance impede AI infrastructure.

Huang warned that excessive regulation could hinder the open‑source AI ecosystem still developing in the U.S., and for NVIDIA, a diverse and competitive set of model developers not only sustains market demand but also provides the U.S. with alternatives to counter China’s open‑source models.

items.title_en: Borrowing to Build AI Data Centers! Goldman Sachs: Debt Issuance by the Five Tech Giants to Rise 68% Next Year, Up to $420 Billion
paras: AI資本支出持續擴張，債務融資比重升高，信用市場迎來新一輪供給壓力

高盛9月17日發布最新報告，將亞馬遜、Alphabet、Meta Platforms、微軟與甲骨文五家科技巨頭2027年全球投資級債務發行規模預估，從約4000億美元上調至4200億美元，較2026年全年預估的2500億美元增加約68%。高盛表示，人工智慧(AI)基礎設施建設仍處於高投入階段，企業資本支出持續上修，債務融資在未來數年將扮演更重要角色。相關數據也顯示，AI投資的融資需求已不再局限於大型科技公司，而是逐步擴散至資料中心、半導體、電力、能源、設備及房地產等產業。
此次預測涵蓋Amazon.com (AMZN-US)、Alphabet (GOOGL-US)、Meta Platforms (META-US)、Microsoft (MSFT-US)與Oracle (ORCL-US)。高盛上調發債預期，主要是因最新一輪財報公布後，相關企業的資本支出預測進一步增加。高盛認為，AI基礎設施供需失衡仍可能延續，高投入週期至少持續至2027年底。
資料中心建設、伺服器採購及算力部署都需要在收入與現金回報形成之前投入大量資金，因此資本支出與回報之間的時間差，使債務成為大型科技企業平衡資金需求的重要工具。高盛估計，2027年五大科技巨頭約35%的資本支出將由債務支持，若以4200億美元發債規模推算，五家公司2027年資本支出可能達到約1.2兆美元。
圖表：高盛對五大科技巨頭2026、2027年債務發行規模的估算。
2026年全年發債預測為2500億美元，截至9月14日，五家公司已發行約2290億美元，相當於全年預測的約92%。不過，資本支出持續增加並不代表發債規模會永久同步上升。高盛圖表顯示，資本支出預計延續成長至2030年，但債務融資占比將在2027年之後逐步下降，2030年約降至25%。實際融資規模仍取決於企業內部現金創造能力及整體融資結構。
需要注意的是，4200億美元僅涵蓋五大科技巨頭的全球投資級債務發行，不包括資料中心及晶片項目融資。高盛預計，2027年這部分融資規模可能達到3000億美元。兩者若單純相加為7200億美元，但這並不能視為高盛對整個AI產業鏈融資總額的預測，因為兩者屬於不同融資類別。
AI融資潮的規模也已遠超大型科技企業本身。高盛統計，截至2026年9月中旬，全球AI相關債務發行總額已達5780億美元，其中超大規模雲端業者約占四成，其餘約六成來自資料中心及項目融資、半導體、軟體、設備、電力與能源等上下游產業。
圖表：高盛估算2026年全球AI相關債務中，超大規模雲端業者約占40%，其餘60%來自更廣泛的AI基礎設施供應鏈。
從信用市場類型來看，約4900億美元來自全球投資級市場，另有約880億美元來自全球槓桿融資市場。投資級融資主體包括超大規模雲端業者、資料中心與項目融資、半導體及記憶體企業、軟體與服務公司、PC與設備廠商、資料中心及儲存REIT，以及科技業投資級定期貸款等。
AI基礎設施的資金需求也開始延伸至公用事業、能源、機械、化工與鋼鐵等傳統產業。為避免高估AI融資規模，高盛在統計這些「AI鄰近產業」時，僅將其總發行量的30%計入AI相關融資，同時剔除尚未提款的信用額度、循環信貸及尚未完成的融資。
這種融資結構反映AI投資已從晶片與雲端運算企業向實體基礎設施擴散。資料中心不僅需要伺服器與儲存設備，也需要大量電力、輸電網路、冷卻設備、土地與房地產，以及相應的長期融資。隨著AI基礎設施擴張，越來越多傳統產業的資本需求都與AI建設形成連結。
在2027年五大科技巨頭預計發行的4200億美元債務中，高盛估計約65%至75%可能在美元投資級債券市場完成，相當於約2730億至3150億美元。最終比例仍取決於市場環境，以及投資人對科技巨頭發行人集中度升高的接受程度。
高盛認為，五大科技企業的債務規模仍有擴張空間。與摩根大通、摩根士丹利及美國銀行等目前美元投資級市場大型發行人相比，五大科技巨頭符合指數納入條件的存量債券規模整體仍有較大的擴張空間。
與此同時，歐元債券市場可能在未來承擔更多AI融資。今年以來，歐元市場吸收的AI相關債務占比仍相對有限，但歐元投資級債券市場是美元之外少數具備足夠規模、可承接大型企業融資的市場之一。英鎊、日元、加元、澳元及瑞郎企業債市場整體規模則相對較小。高盛也預期，可轉換債券未來可能在AI基礎設施融資中發揮更大作用。
AI相關企業債券與其他投資級債券的信用利差表現也出現分化。高盛指出，2026年以來，AI相關美元投資級債券利差明顯走闊，而非AI債券整體相對穩定。其中，超大規模雲端業者的累計利差擴大最明顯，軟體公司其次，硬體企業此前則相對具有韌性。
高盛並不認為硬體企業可以長期免受影響。隨著計算設備出貨增加及相關融資需求擴大，硬體企業未來也可能面臨更明顯的信用供給壓力。對股票投資人而言，AI投資的核心問題通常是收入與利潤成長；對債券投資人而言，則更關注資本支出如何融資、企業是否需要提高槓桿，以及持續的大量債券供給是否推高信用利差並壓縮相對估值。
圖表：高盛估算AI相關債券占主要信用債券指數的比重。
高盛估算，目前AI相關債券約占彭博美元投資級企業債指數12%，在美元高收益債指數中的占比約6%；歐洲市場目前相對較低，AI相關債務約占歐元投資級指數3%、歐元高收益債指數1%。作為比較，銀行業約占美元投資級企業債市場22%，占歐元投資級企業債市場31%。
這意味著AI債券目前尚未大到足以完全主導整個信用市場，但如果當前融資週期持續多年，其指數權重仍可能進一步上升。高盛認為，AI相關債券的壓力目前並未明顯拖累整體美元投資級市場，一方面是美國經濟活動仍具支撐，企業信用基本面整體仍相對穩健，高絕對收益率也持續吸引追求收益的投資人；另一方面，銀行、能源與醫療等大型產業與AI投資週期的相關性較低，為信用指數提供分散效果。
不過，高盛仍提醒，隨著AI基礎設施建設進入多年期投資週期，一旦市場情緒改善、信用利差收窄，企業可能利用較有利的融資窗口加快發債，進一步形成供給壓力。對資料中心及算力項目的融資，高盛也認為投資人需要採取選擇性策略，並評估個別項目的信用與現金流風險。
paras_en: AI capital spending continues to expand, raising the share of debt financing and creating a new wave of supply pressure in the credit market.

Goldman Sachs released a new report on September 17, estimating that the 2027 global investment‑grade debt issuance of the five tech giants—Amazon, Alphabet, Meta Platforms, Microsoft and Oracle—will be revised up from about $400 billion to $420 billion, roughly a 68% increase over the 2026 full‑year estimate of $250 billion. The bank says AI infrastructure construction remains in a high‑investment phase, corporate capex is being revised upward, and debt financing will play an increasingly important role in the coming years. Data also show that financing demand for AI is no longer confined to the big tech firms but is spreading to data centers, semiconductors, power, energy, equipment and real‑estate sectors.

The forecast covers Amazon.com (AMZN‑US), Alphabet (GOOGL‑US), Meta Platforms (META‑US), Microsoft (MSFT‑US) and Oracle (ORCL‑US). Goldman raised its issuance expectations mainly because the latest earnings releases pushed corporate capex forecasts higher. The bank believes the supply‑demand imbalance for AI infrastructure could persist, with a high‑investment cycle lasting at least until the end of 2027.

Data‑center construction, server procurement and compute deployment require large upfront cash outlays before revenue and cash returns materialize, creating a timing gap between capex and returns. This makes debt an important tool for large tech firms to balance funding needs. Goldman estimates that about 35% of the five giants’ 2027 capex will be debt‑financed; at a $420 billion issuance level, their total 2027 capex could reach roughly $1.2 trillion.
Chart: Goldman’s estimates of debt issuance for the five tech giants in 2026 and 2027.

The 2026 full‑year issuance forecast is $250 billion; as of September 14 the five companies had issued about $229 billion, roughly 92% of the annual target. However, rising capex does not mean issuance will keep pace forever. Goldman’s chart shows capex is expected to keep growing through 2030, while the share of debt financing will gradually fall after 2027, reaching about 25% by 2030. Actual financing volumes will still depend on each company’s internal cash generation and overall financing structure.

It should be noted that the $420 billion figure only covers the five tech giants’ global investment‑grade debt issuance and does not include financing for data‑center and chip projects. Goldman expects that portion of financing could reach $300 billion in 2027. Added together the two would total $720 billion, but this should not be taken as Goldman’s estimate of total financing for the entire AI value chain, as the two categories are distinct.

The scale of the AI financing wave has already far outstripped the tech giants themselves. Goldman’s data show that by mid‑September 2026, total global AI‑related debt issuance had reached $578 billion, with ultra‑large cloud providers accounting for about 40% and the remaining roughly 60% coming from data‑center and project financing, semiconductors, software, equipment, power and energy downstream industries.
Chart: Goldman’s estimate that in 2026 global AI‑related debt, ultra‑large cloud providers represent about 40%, the other 60% coming from the broader AI infrastructure supply chain.

From a credit‑market perspective, about $4.9 trillion comes from the global investment‑grade market and roughly $880 billion from the global leveraged market. Investment‑grade issuers include ultra‑large cloud providers, data‑center and project financing, semiconductor and memory firms, software and services companies, PC and equipment manufacturers, data‑center and storage REITs, and tech‑sector investment‑grade term loans.

AI infrastructure funding needs are also extending into utilities, energy, machinery, chemicals and steel – traditional industries. To avoid overstating AI financing, Goldman counts only 30% of the total issuance of these “AI‑adjacent” sectors as AI‑related financing, and excludes undrawn credit lines, revolving facilities and unfinished financings.

This financing structure reflects that AI investment is spreading from chip and cloud computing firms to physical infrastructure. Data centers need not only servers and storage but also large amounts of power, transmission networks, cooling equipment, land, real estate and corresponding long‑term financing. As AI infrastructure expands, more traditional industries’ capital needs become linked to AI construction.

Of the $420 billion of debt the five tech giants are expected to issue in 2027, Goldman estimates that roughly 65%‑75% could be placed in the U.S. investment‑grade bond market, equivalent to about $2.73 trillion to $3.15 trillion. The final share will depend on market conditions and investors’ tolerance for the increasing concentration of issuers among the tech giants.

Goldman believes the debt scale of the five tech firms still has room to grow. Compared with current large issuers in the U.S. investment‑grade market such as JPMorgan, Morgan Stanley and Bank of America, the five giants have considerable expansion potential for index‑eligible bond stock.

At the same time, the euro‑bond market may take on more AI financing in the future. So far this year the euro market’s share of AI‑related debt has been relatively limited, but the euro investment‑grade bond market is one of the few non‑dollar markets large enough to accommodate big‑company financing. The overall size of corporate bond markets in pounds, yen, Canadian dollars, Australian dollars and Swiss francs is smaller. Goldman also expects convertible bonds to play a larger role in AI infrastructure financing going forward.

Credit spreads for AI‑related corporate bonds have begun to diverge from other investment‑grade bonds. Goldman notes that since 2026 AI‑related U.S. investment‑grade bond spreads have widened noticeably, while non‑AI bonds have remained relatively stable. Among them, ultra‑large cloud providers have seen the biggest cumulative spread expansion, followed by software firms, while hardware companies have so far shown more resilience.

Goldman does not think hardware firms can avoid impact indefinitely. As shipments of computing equipment rise and related financing needs expand, hardware firms may also face stronger credit‑supply pressure. For equity investors the core AI question is revenue and profit growth; for bond investors the focus is how capex is financed, whether firms need to raise leverage, and whether a sustained flood of bonds will push spreads higher and compress relative valuations.
Chart: Goldman’s estimate of the share of AI‑related bonds within major credit‑bond indices.

Goldman estimates AI‑related bonds now make up about 12% of the Bloomberg U.S. investment‑grade corporate bond index and roughly 6% of the U.S. high‑yield index; in Europe the figures are lower, about 3% of the euro investment‑grade index and 1% of the euro high‑yield index. By comparison, banks account for about 22% of the U.S. investment‑grade market and 31% of the euro investment‑grade market.

This means AI bonds are not yet large enough to dominate the entire credit market, but if the current financing cycle lasts for many years their index weight could rise further. Goldman says AI‑related bond pressure has not yet noticeably dragged down the overall U.S. investment‑grade market because U.S. economic activity still provides support, corporate credit fundamentals remain relatively sound and high absolute yields continue to attract yield‑seeking investors. Moreover, large sectors such as banking, energy and healthcare have low correlation with the AI investment cycle, providing diversification for credit indices.

However, Goldman cautions that as AI infrastructure moves into a multi‑year investment cycle, an improvement in market sentiment and narrowing spreads could give companies a more favorable financing window, prompting faster issuance and adding supply pressure. For data‑center and compute‑capacity projects, Goldman also advises investors to adopt selective strategies and assess the credit and cash‑flow risks of individual projects.

items.title: 川普罕見親往機場迎接習近平！預告將達成多項協議 白宮國宴廣邀黃仁勳與庫克
items.title_en: Trump Rarely Personally Greets Xi at Airport, Announces Multiple Agreements; White House State Dinner Broadly Invites Jensen Huang and Tim Cook
paras: 美國總統川普計劃在中國國家主席習近平下周抵達華盛頓地區時親自接機，他周五(18日)表示，下周與習近平的會面將促成「多項不同協議」，他形容美中兩國「相處得非常好」，預期雙方將進行一次「非常好的會面」。
習近平預定下周訪問華盛頓，並於9月24日與川普會談，川普計劃在他抵達時，親自前往華盛頓特區外的安德魯斯聯合基地(Joint Base Andrews)機場迎接。由美國總統親自在機場迎接來訪外國領袖，相當罕見。
川普在白宮橢圓形辦公室接受記者提問時表示：「習主席和我關係很好。我們將會在這裡達成多項不同協議……我們將會進行一次非常好的會面。」
川普表示，美中兩國「相處得非常好」，並提到美國對中國商品加徵的關稅。
他說：「中國正在向我們支付很多關稅。」川普提到，關稅一度高達145%，之後他將稅率調降，並表示145%的高關稅「真的讓他們受到嚴重打擊」。

習近平將訪問白宮

美國一名高級官員向記者表示，習近平此行將前往白宮訪問，包括在白宮舉行抵達儀式，並在玫瑰園接受軍事檢閱，晚間則舉行國宴。

官員表示，晚宴賓客包括多名科技業執行長，包括亞馬遜(AMZN-US)創辦人貝佐斯(Jeff Bezos)、Alphabet(GOOGL-US)執行長皮查伊(Sundar Pichai)、OpenAI執行長奧特曼(Sam Altman)、蘋果(AAPL-US)執行長庫克、特斯拉(TSLA-US)執行長馬斯克、輝達(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳(Jensen Huang)，以及戴爾科技(Dell Technologies)(DELL-US)執行長戴爾(Michael Dell)。
官員表示，雙方預料將討論貿易、稀土流向全球經濟的供應，以及AI等議題。
川普表示，白宮宴會廳尚未開放令人感到遺憾，否則他原本可以在習近平訪美期間舉辦一場約2000人參加的晚宴。

川普：美中互相從事間諜活動

被問及外界對中國對待記者方式的疑慮時，川普表示：「我不知道。我認為我們也很壓制，我們有假新聞。我們沒有壓制，但他們寫假新聞。」
川普也表示，美中兩國彼此都在從事間諜活動。他解釋說：「有人說：『喔，他們在監視我們。』我就說：『也許他們有，但我們也在監視他們。』」他並補充，不會透露機密資訊。

以下白宮公布川習預定會面的行程：

9月23日 周三

習近平與夫人彭麗媛抵達華盛頓特區郊外的安德魯斯聯合基地。
川普將在機場迎接習近平，雙方並參加抵達儀式。美國總統親自在軍事基地機場迎接外國領袖相當罕見。


9月24日 周四
川普與習近平白天舉行會談，晚間出席國宴。

川普將在白宮迎接習近平與彭麗媛。
川普與習近平前往玫瑰園接受軍事檢閱，隨後展開雙邊會談。
美國第一夫人梅蘭妮亞(Melania Trump)與彭麗媛將在華盛頓地區出席另一場活動，白宮尚未立即公布相關活動細節。
晚間，川普夫婦將在白宮東廳(East Room)設國宴款待習近平與彭麗媛。川普與習近平將在晚宴開始時致詞，出席賓客包括多名科技與金融業高階主管。


9月25日 周五

茶敘、參訪與離境。
川普夫婦將在白宮與習近平、彭麗媛茶敘。
雙方將前往華盛頓的美國國家檔案館(National Archives)，參觀美國建國相關文件。
習近平與彭麗媛前往安德魯斯聯合基地，隨後離境。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Friday (the 18th) that he plans to personally receive Chinese President Xi Jinping at the airport when Xi arrives in the Washington area next week, and that their meeting will produce “a number of different agreements.” He described U.S.–China relations as “going very well” and expects a “very good meeting.”

Xi Jinping is scheduled to visit Washington next week and to hold talks with Trump on September 24. Trump plans to meet him at Joint Base Andrews outside Washington, D.C., a rare occasion for a sitting U.S. president to greet a foreign leader at the airport.
Speaking to reporters in the Oval Office, Trump said, “President Xi and I have a great relationship. We will reach a number of different agreements here… we will have a very good meeting.”
Trump added that the United States and China “get along very well,” and referenced the tariffs the U.S. has imposed on Chinese goods.
He said, “China is paying us a lot of tariffs.” Trump noted that the tariff rate had once reached 145%, that he later lowered it, and that the 145% rate “really hit them hard.”

A senior U.S. official told reporters that Xi’s trip will include a visit to the White House, with a arrival ceremony on the White House grounds, a military review on the Rose Garden, and an evening state dinner.

The official said the dinner guests will include several tech CEOs: Amazon founder Jeff Bezos, Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai, OpenAI chief Sam Altman, Apple CEO Tim Cook, Tesla CEO Elon Musk, NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang, and Dell Technologies CEO Michael Dell.
The official said the two sides are expected to discuss trade, the global supply of rare‑earth elements, and topics such as artificial intelligence.
Trump said it was a pity that the White House’s banquet hall is not yet open; otherwise he could have hosted a dinner for about 2,000 guests during Xi’s U.S. visit.

Trump on U.S.–China espionage: When asked about concerns over China’s treatment of journalists, he replied, “I don’t know. I think we also suppress, we have fake news. We don’t suppress, but they write fake news.”

Trump also said both countries are engaged in spying on each other. He explained, “People say, ‘Oh, they’re watching us.’ I say, ‘Maybe they are, but we’re watching them too.’” He added that he would not disclose classified information.
The White House released the schedule for the planned Trump‑Xi meeting:

September 23, Wednesday – Xi and his wife Peng Liyuan arrive at Joint Base Andrews outside Washington, D.C. Trump will greet Xi at the airport and both will take part in an arrival ceremony. It is unusual for a U.S. president to personally receive a foreign leader at a military‑base airport.
September 24, Thursday – Trump and Xi hold talks during the day and attend the state dinner in the evening.

Trump will receive Xi and Peng Liyuan at the White House. They will go to the Rose Garden for a military review, followed by bilateral talks. First Lady Melania Trump and Peng Liyuan will attend a separate event in the Washington area; details have not been released. In the evening, Trump and his wife will host a state dinner for Xi and Peng Liyuan in the East Room, with speeches at the start and a guest list that includes many senior tech and finance executives.

items.title: 台亞旗下積亞SiC技術輸出印度RIR Power新廠3個月內投產
items.title_en: Taiya's Jiya SiC Technology Exported to India's RIR Power New Plant, Production to Start Within Three Months
paras: 2026年09月19日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 印度功率半導體業者RIR Power Electronics位於Bhubaneswar Info Valley-II電子製造聚落的碳化矽(SiC)磊晶晶圓廠已完成主要設備安裝，董事長Harshad Mehta表示，預計3個月內開始投產，印度SiC本土供應鏈進一步從政策與投資階段走向實際生產。
RIR Power在該項目投資約61.8億盧比，第一階段將先建立SiC磊晶與封裝能力，預計2026年底前生產約750片SiC磊晶晶圓，2027年底前進一步擴大至2萬片，後續並規劃向晶圓製造(fab)延伸。
從整體規劃來看，RIR Power正逐步建立從SiC磊晶、晶圓製造到封裝的垂直整合能力。公司較早期規劃包括設置2台磊晶反應爐，日產能40片晶圓，後續建置6吋晶圓製造及封裝產線，月產能最高3,500片，產品涵蓋SiC MOSFET、二極體及模組。
印度其他SiC項目也同步推進。SiCSem正在Bhubaneswar規劃大型SiC晶圓廠，投資約206.6億盧比，規劃年產6萬片晶圓及9,600萬顆封裝元件，目標2027至2028年投產。相較之下，RIR Power規模較小，但已進入設備安裝完成、準備投產階段。
SiC主要應用於電動車、工業設備等高功率領域，目前全球供應鏈主要由Wolfspeed(WOLF-US)、意法半導體STMicroelectronics(STM-US)及日本業者等供應。隨印度陸續增加SiC磊晶、晶圓製造與封裝投資，本土供應能力也開始建立。
政策支持則提供後續擴產條件。奧里薩邦規劃針對符合Semicon 2.0的晶片項目，額外提供25%資本支出補貼，有利於吸引更多半導體製造投資。
RIR Power的SiC技術來源也有台廠參與，合作夥伴包括台亞半導體(2340-TW)旗下積亞半導體(PASC)及美國Sicamore Semi，合作範圍涵蓋SiC相關智慧財產權(IP)與生產技術。積亞本身碳化矽蕭特基二極體(SiC SBD)月產能達2,300片，並布局晶圓廠技術移轉(fab transfer)及海外技術合作。

paras_en: On September 19, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – India’s power semiconductor company RIR Power Electronics has completed the installation of major equipment at its silicon carbide (SiC) epitaxial wafer fab located in the Bhubaneswar Info Valley‑II electronics manufacturing cluster. Chairman Harshad Mehta said production is expected to commence within three months, moving India’s domestic SiC supply chain from policy and investment stages to actual manufacturing.

RIR Power is investing roughly 6.18 billion rupees in the project. In the first phase it will establish SiC epitaxy and packaging capabilities, aiming to produce about 750 SiC epitaxial wafers by the end of 2026 and expand to 20,000 wafers by the end of 2027, with later plans to extend into full‑fab wafer manufacturing.

Overall, RIR Power is gradually building a vertically integrated capability from SiC epitaxy through wafer fabrication to packaging. Early plans include installing two epitaxial reactors with a daily capacity of 40 wafers, followed by a 6‑inch wafer fab and packaging line capable of up to 3,500 wafers per month, producing SiC MOSFETs, diodes and modules.

Other SiC projects in India are progressing in parallel. SiCSem is planning a large SiC wafer fab in Bhubaneswar with an investment of about 20.66 billion rupees, targeting an annual output of 60,000 wafers and 96 million packaged devices, slated for commissioning in 2027‑2028. Compared with that, RIR Power’s scale is smaller but it has already completed equipment installation and is ready to start production.

SiC is primarily used in high‑power applications such as electric vehicles and industrial equipment. The global supply chain is currently dominated by Wolfspeed (WOLF‑US), STMicroelectronics (STM‑US) and Japanese firms. As India continues to add SiC epitaxy, wafer fabrication and packaging investments, domestic supply capacity is beginning to take shape.

Policy support provides conditions for further expansion. Odisha state plans to offer an additional 25% capital‑expenditure subsidy for chip projects that meet the Semicon 2.0 criteria, helping attract more semiconductor manufacturing investment.

RIR Power’s SiC technology also involves Taiwanese partners. Collaborators include Taiwan Semiconductor (ticker 2340‑TW) subsidiary Jiya Semiconductor (PASC) and U.S. firm Sicamore Semi, covering SiC‑related intellectual property and production technology. Jiya itself has a monthly capacity of 2,300 SiC Schottky diodes and is pursuing fab technology transfer and overseas tech cooperation.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元維持逾7周高點 Fed立場偏鷹
items.title_en: <New York FX Market> Dollar Holds Over 7‑Week High as Fed Takes Hawkish Stance
paras: 美元周五(18日)走弱，但在美國聯準會(Fed)升息提振下，本周創3個月來最佳單周表現。同時，市場焦點轉向日元走弱。日本銀行(BoJ)將利率升至31年高點，但市場認為升息幅度及後續政策訊號不夠強硬，導致日元走跌。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.1%，報100.22。本周上漲約1.1%，創6月中旬以來最佳單周表現。
本周市場焦點集中在央行升息。聯準會公開市場委員會(FOMC)周三一致投票決定，將聯邦資金利率由3.50%至3.75%上調至3.75%至4.00%。此外，更新後的「經濟預測摘要」，以及聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)在決策後的記者會，都釋放出明顯偏鷹訊號。
在FOMC公布決策前，市場對聯準會升息的預期機率一度飆升至90%，主要受到油價飆升、美國經濟數據，以及債券市場持續遭拋售等因素推動。
固定收益投資人尤其對升息決定表示肯定，認為這顯示聯準會並未落後於通膨走勢，進而推動美國公債殖利率周四上升。不過，殖利率周五再度走高，其中10年期美債殖利率最新上升6.1個基點至5.008%。本周稍早，該殖利率一度飆升至逾19年高點。
Interactive Brokers的Torres表示，最新一波美債殖利率上升，與日元走跌有關。
他表示，「日元貶值對美國公債形成阻力，因東京是美國公債最大的海外持有者。日元走弱會逐步迫使日本當局出售美國公債，以籌措現金干預外匯市場，進而支撐日元匯率。」
日銀被認為不夠鷹派
日銀將基準政策利率上調25個基點至1.25%。這項升息符合市場普遍預期，當前日本正面臨日元疲弱與能源成本飆升的雙重壓力。
一般而言，利率走高往往有利於貨幣升值。然而，此次升息並未帶動日本資產上漲，反而觸發外匯交易市場一波獲利了結。投資人原本期待日銀採取更積極升息策略，但兩名審議委員對此次升息持異議，投票主張維持利率不變，令央行的鷹派立場有所軟化，也降低市場對後續快速緊縮的預期。
日銀總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)在決策公布後表示，此次行動是為了提前因應，以避免日後被迫採取劇烈措施，但他也強調，日銀並未考慮採取激進的貨幣政策衝擊療法。
Interactive Brokers資深經濟學家José Torres表示，「儘管植田表示，若有需要，他將支持進一步升息，但兩名政策制定者反對昨日的升息決定，使部分投資人開始質疑，如果通膨未能降溫，日銀是否有決心積極收緊貨幣政策，這也導致日元兌美元跌至兩周低點。」
周五稍晚，日元一度大幅收復部分跌幅。因《日本經濟新聞》報導，日銀已進行所謂的利率檢查，即聯絡外匯市場參與者，詢問目前的匯率水準。市場通常將利率檢查視為潛在外匯干預前的初步行動。
今年以來，日本當局已投入超過15兆日元(約957億美元)支撐日元匯率。
日元周五一度跌至1美元兌158.05日元，隨後收復部分跌幅，最高回升至155.88。本周創下2025年10月以來最差單周表現。

paras_en: The dollar weakened on Friday (the 18th), but boosted by the Federal Reserve’s rate hike it delivered its best weekly performance in three months this week. Meanwhile, market focus shifted to the weakening yen. The Bank of Japan raised rates to a 31‑year high, but markets judged the size of the hike and subsequent policy signals as insufficiently aggressive, sending the yen lower.

In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, fell 0.1% to 100.22. The index is up about 1.1% for the week, marking its strongest weekly gain since mid‑June.

The week’s market focus centered on central‑bank rate hikes. The Federal Open Market Committee voted unanimously on Wednesday to raise the federal funds target range from 3.50%‑3.75% to 3.75%‑4.00%. In addition, the updated Summary of Economic Projections and Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s post‑decision press conference both conveyed a clearly hawkish tone.
Ahead of the FOMC announcement, market expectations for a Fed hike briefly spiked to 90%, driven mainly by soaring oil prices, U.S. economic data and continued bond‑market selling pressure.

Fixed‑income investors welcomed the rate‑hike decision, seeing it as evidence that the Fed is not lagging behind inflation, which pushed U.S. Treasury yields higher on Thursday. However, yields rose again on Friday, with the 10‑year Treasury yield climbing 6.1 basis points to 5.008%. Earlier in the week the yield had surged to a 19‑year high.
Torres of Interactive Brokers said the latest wave of Treasury‑yield gains is linked to the yen’s decline.

He explained, “A weaker yen creates resistance for U.S. Treasuries because Tokyo is the largest overseas holder of U.S. government debt. A falling yen will gradually force Japanese authorities to sell Treasuries to raise cash for foreign‑exchange intervention, thereby supporting the yen.”
The Bank of Japan is seen as insufficiently hawkish
The BOJ lifted its benchmark policy rate by 25 basis points to 1.25%. The move was broadly expected as Japan faces a double squeeze of a weak yen and soaring energy costs.

Generally, higher rates tend to support currency appreciation. This time, however, the hike did not lift Japanese assets and instead sparked profit‑taking in the FX market. Investors had hoped the BOJ would adopt a more aggressive tightening path, but two board members opposed the move, voting to keep rates unchanged, which softened the central bank’s hawkish stance and lowered expectations for rapid further tightening.

BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda said after the decision that the action was taken pre‑emptively to avoid having to resort to drastic measures later, but he stressed the bank has not considered adopting an aggressive monetary‑policy shock approach.

Senior economist José Torres of Interactive Brokers noted, “Even though Governor Ueda said he would support further hikes if needed, the opposition of two policymakers to yesterday’s hike has led some investors to question whether the BOJ is truly committed to aggressive tightening if inflation does not cool, contributing to the yen’s slide to a two‑week low against the dollar.”

Later on Friday, the yen briefly reclaimed part of its losses after the Nikkei reported that the BOJ had conducted a so‑called rate check – contacting FX market participants to gauge current exchange‑rate levels. Markets usually view a rate check as a preliminary step before possible foreign‑exchange intervention.
Since the start of the year, Japanese authorities have deployed more than ¥15 trillion (about $95.7 billion) to support the yen.
The yen fell to ¥158.05 per dollar on Friday before partially recovering, climbing back up to a high of ¥155.88. The week marked its worst performance since October 2025.

items.title: 日銀升息也救不了日元？跌近158後傳出詢價 市場緊盯干預
items.title_en: Can BOJ Rate Hikes Still Not Save the Yen? After Falling Near 158, a Quote Request Sparks Market Watch for Intervention
paras: 日元周五(18日)在日本央行升息後一度重貶，跌至接近1美元兌158日元，但《日本經濟新聞》報導，日本央行向市場人士詢問匯率水準後，日元跌幅收斂。市場通常將這類「匯率詢價」視為官方可能干預匯市的前兆，但目前尚無當局實際進場的消息。
紐約時間下午1時20分左右，日元報1美元兌156.70日元，仍貶值0.5%，但已收復盤中最多1.3%的跌幅。《日本經濟新聞》未說明消息來源；日本財務省在非辦公時間也未能立即回應置評要求。
日本央行稍早如預期升息，但總裁植田和男對後續升息路徑的說法未能滿足市場偏鷹派的期待。他表示，貨幣政策已進入新階段，但目前難以判定本輪升息的最終利率。此外，兩名決策委員對升息投下反對票，增添未來升息速度與幅度的不確定性。
美國銀行匯率策略師Alex Cohen指出，日銀才剛升息，日元卻仍急貶，這次詢價形同再向市場發出警告。日本財務省先前已展現動用大量外匯存底干預的意願，押注日元續貶的交易員不能忽視這項訊號。
日元7月曾跌至約1美元兌164日元，創40年低點，隨後美日聯手買進日元，為1998年以來首見。日本財務省數據顯示，截至8月26日的一個月內，日本干預匯市支出達創紀錄的15.4兆日元。如今日本進入連續假期，交易量較低，任何官方行動都可能放大短線波動。
不過，日元仍面臨美日利差壓力。聯準會(Fed)重啟升息，可能削弱日銀升息對日元的支撐，讓借入低息日元、投資高收益資產的交易持續具有吸引力。匯市干預或許能迅速打擊押注日元貶值的部位，但能否扭轉長期走勢，仍取決於兩國貨幣政策的變化。
paras_en: The yen briefly slumped on Friday (the 18th) after the Bank of Japan raised rates, dropping to near ¥158 per $1, but after the BOJ queried market participants about the exchange‑rate level, the yen’s decline narrowed. Such “rate quotes” are usually seen as a pre‑signal that officials may step into the FX market, though no concrete intervention has been reported yet.

Around 1:20 p.m. New York time, the yen was quoted at ¥156.70 per $1, still down 0.5% but having recovered most of the intra‑day 1.3% fall. The Nikkei did not disclose its source; the Ministry of Finance, out of office, did not immediately respond to comment requests.

The BOJ earlier this week raised rates as expected, but Governor Kazuo Ueda’s comments on the future tightening path fell short of the market’s hawkish hopes. He said monetary policy has entered a new stage but it is still too early to determine the final rate for this round. Moreover, two policy‑board members voted against the hike, adding uncertainty to the pace and magnitude of future tightening.

Bank of America FX strategist Alex Cohen noted that the BOJ just raised rates yet the yen is still sharply weakening, and this quote request is essentially another warning to the market. The Ministry of Finance has previously shown willingness to use large foreign‑exchange reserves for intervention, a signal that traders betting on further yen depreciation cannot ignore.

The yen fell to about ¥164 per $1 in July, a 40‑year low, before the U.S. and Japan jointly bought yen – the first such coordinated action since 1998. Ministry data show that in the month ending August 26, Japan’s FX‑market intervention spending hit a record ¥15.4 trillion. With Japan now on a consecutive holiday and trading volume low, any official move could amplify short‑term volatility.

Nevertheless, the yen remains under pressure from the U.S.–Japan interest‑rate differential. The Fed’s renewed rate hikes could blunt the BOJ’s rate‑rise support for the yen, keeping the carry‑trade of borrowing cheap yen to invest in higher‑yield assets attractive. Intervention may quickly hit positions betting on yen weakness, but whether it can reverse the longer‑term trend still depends on the evolution of both countries’ monetary policies.

items.title: 〈台幣〉熱錢回流股匯雙漲 爆量走升收31.808元
items.title_en: Taiwan Dollar: Hot Money Returns, Stocks and Exchange Rate Rise, Volume Surges, Closing at 31.808

paras_en: U.S. rate hikes by one percentage point removed uncertainties, and with hot‑money inflows, Taipei’s stock and foreign‑exchange markets both rose on the 18th. items.title: 日銀總裁的「鷹派立場」未讓市場理解及接受 日元跌勢加劇
items.title_en: Bank of Japan Governor's Hawkish Stance Not Understood or Accepted by Market, Yen Decline Accelerates
paras: 日本央行總裁植田和男周五(18日)在記者會上，傳達出對於升息更為積極的鷹派姿態，然而日元不僅未能止跌，跌勢反倒進一步擴大。分析師指出，主因是植田的說法未讓投資者理解及滿意。
日本外匯市場周五傍晚，日元兌美元匯率一度跌至157區間後段，較紐約市場收盤時的跌幅達1.2%。日本央行在貨幣政策會議上將政策利率從之前的1%上調至1.25%，植田則重申繼續升息立場。

短期承壓：政策訊息混淆

Reed Capital 投資總監 Gerald Gan 表示，儘管植田試圖平息市場情緒，但他仍維持短期內日元將持續疲軟的看法，並強調日銀與美國聯準會(Fed)在前瞻指引上的分歧，正成為影響日元穩定的主要疑慮。
富國銀行(Wells Fargo)亞太區策略負責人 Chidu Narayana 指出，植田的鷹派態度不足以支持市場原本過於激進的期待，在缺乏明確鷹派信號與美元反彈下，美元兌日元匯率將維持高位。
Stonex Financial 利率主管 Shriya Samarth 認為，日銀傳遞的訊息相當混淆，既承認政策優先順序改變，又不願承諾面對通膨上行風險，難以被市場認定為足夠鷹派。T&D 資產管理首席策略師Hiroshi Namioka補充，市場難解讀植田的發言，導致日元短暫走強後再度重回貶勢。

結構性壓力與市場干預風險

Pictet Asset Management Japan 投資策略部長田中純平分析，植田宣示「政策營運階段改變」，雖有助於消除市場對日銀落後於曲線的疑慮，但受制於日元面臨的結構性下行壓力，加上市場預期的日美升息步調差異有限，僅憑本次會議結果難以觸發持續性的日元升值行情。
此外，他提醒連休期間交易清淡，投資人仍需戒備日美政府進行協調干預的可能性，預期美元兌日元將持續劇烈波動且缺乏明確方向。

部分分析師看好日元中長期走升

不過，部分分析師持較為樂觀的態度。SMBC 信託銀行投資調查部長山口真弘認為，植田成功化解了記者會可能引發日元急跌的風險，且日銀的基本立場並未改變，市場仍維持每3個月升息一次(如今年 12 月)的預期，因此不認為日元會陷入長期走貶趨勢。
State Street Investment Management 資深固定收益策略師Masahiko Loo強調，市場不應過度解讀兩位審議委員的反對票，美元兌日元在 160 附近仍宜採取逢高賣出策略。他預測，隨著日銀政策正常化帶動國內殖利率上升、日本資產吸引機構資金回流，以及 AI 相關投資增加等三大結構性因素，日元中長期走勢將逐漸獲得支撐。
paras_en: Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda on Friday (the 18th) conveyed a more aggressive hawkish stance toward rate hikes at a press conference, yet the yen not only failed to stop falling, its decline actually widened. Analysts said the main reason was that Ueda's remarks did not resonate with or satisfy investors.

In the Japanese foreign‑exchange market on Friday evening, the yen slipped to the lower end of the 157 range against the dollar, a 1.2% drop from the New York close. The BOJ raised its policy rate from 1.0% to 1.25% at its monetary‑policy meeting, and Ueda reiterated the commitment to continue raising rates.

Short‑term pressure: mixed policy signals
Gerald Gan, Investment Director at Reed Capital, said that despite Ueda’s attempt to calm market sentiment, he still expects the yen to remain weak in the short run and highlighted the growing divergence between the BOJ and the U.S. Federal Reserve on forward guidance as a key concern for yen stability.

Chidu Narayana, Head of Asia‑Pacific Strategy at Wells Fargo, noted that Ueda’s hawkish tone was insufficient to meet the market’s overly aggressive expectations, and without a clear hawkish signal and a dollar rebound, the dollar‑yen pair is likely to stay elevated.

Shriya Samarth, Head of Rates at Stonex Financial, said the BOJ’s messaging was quite confusing – it acknowledged a shift in policy priorities but was unwilling to commit to tackling upside inflation risks, making it hard for the market to view the stance as sufficiently hawkish. Hiroshi Namioka, Chief Strategist at T&D Asset Management, added that the market struggled to interpret Ueda’s comments, causing a brief yen rally that quickly reverted to depreciation.

Structural pressure and intervention risk
Junpei Tanaka, Head of Investment Strategy for Japan at Pictet Asset Management, analyzed that Ueda’s declaration of a “change in the policy operating phase” helps allay concerns that the BOJ is lagging behind the yield curve, but the yen faces structural downward pressure and the expected gap between Japan and U.S. rate‑hiking paths is limited, so the meeting outcome alone is unlikely to trigger a sustained yen appreciation rally.

He also warned that trading is thin over the holiday period and investors should remain vigilant about the possibility of coordinated intervention by Japanese and U.S. authorities, expecting the dollar‑yen to continue swinging wildly with no clear direction.

Some analysts are bullish on the yen over the medium to long term
Nevertheless, a few analysts are more optimistic. Masahiro Yamaguchi, Head of Investment Research at SMBC Trust Bank, believes Ueda successfully defused the risk of a sharp yen drop that could have arisen from the press conference, and that the BOJ’s fundamental stance remains unchanged. The market still expects a rate hike every three months (e.g., in December), so he does not see the yen entering a long‑term downtrend.

Masahiko Loo, Senior Fixed‑Income Strategist at State Street Investment Management, stressed that the market should not over‑interpret the dissenting votes of two board members. He recommends selling on rallies near the 160 level for the dollar‑yen. He forecasts that as BOJ policy normalises, domestic yields rise, Japanese assets attract institutional inflows, and AI‑related investments grow, three structural factors will gradually support the yen’s medium‑ to long‑term trajectory.

items.title: 升息過後為何日元摔、日股漲？解析日銀決策被解讀不夠鷹派的三大關鍵
paras: 日本銀行(央行，BOJ)周五(18日)將升息1碼(25個基點)至1.25%，利率創1995年以來最高，且升息間隔從之前的六個月縮短為三個月。儘管升息步調加快，日本金融市場卻出現違反直覺的走勢：日元走弱、10年期日本公債殖利率下滑，日經225指數上漲。
分析師指出，日銀理事會表決出現兩張反對升息票，加上本次升息並未同步公布最新經濟展望，都讓市場解讀日銀不夠鷹派。
目前市場預期，日銀可能在12月左右再次升息，但對利率最終將升至多高卻看法不一。
升息通常會帶動一國貨幣上揚、推升債券殖利率，並對股市造成壓力，但日本的貨幣、債券殖利率與股市周五卻出現完全相反的走勢。截稿前，日元跌破157日元兌1美元，10年期日本政府公債殖利率下滑，日經225指數收盤上漲1.4%。

升息決策7票對2票 市場解讀不夠鷹派

專家指出，日銀理事會出現分歧，是市場出現非典型反應的原因，因為這顯示日本央行可能不會採取過於鷹派的立場。
日本銀行三井住友銀行(SMBC)首席外匯策略師Hirofumi Suzuki說：「兩票反對升息、主張維持利率不變，令人感到意外。」
本次升息決策以七票對兩票通過，理事淺田統一郎(Toichiro Asada)與佐藤綾野(Ayano Sato)投下反對票，他們是由首相高市早苗今年稍早任命、被視為恢復通膨派的人馬。
佐藤綾野指出，由於核心通膨率低於2%，經濟情勢可能還不夠強勁，因此主張維持利率不變。日本8月核心通膨率微降至1.7%，低於7月的1.8%。
淺田統一郎也表示，與先前相比，目前經濟與物價發展似乎沒有大幅加速。

未同步更新經濟展望

道富投資管理公司(State Street Investment Management)資深固定收益策略師Masahiko Loo指出，此次升息未同步公布更新版的經濟展望報告，也是市場反直覺回應的原因之一，因為這限制了日銀透過調整預測來強化鷹派訊息的能力。
牛津經濟學(Oxford Economics)日本經濟主管Shigeto Nagai認同這項看法，他表示，兩名反對升息的理事傳遞的訊號是，高市早苗並未確定接受美國要求日本加快升息的主張。
路透周五報導，美國財長貝森特(Scott Bessent)5月與日本財務大臣片山皋月(Satsuki Katayama)會面時，曾強調日銀需要提高利率。
Nagai進一步補充說：「其次，如果我們觀察聲明，所有措辭與語氣幾乎都與7月公布的季度展望報告相同，因此語氣不像金融市場原本期待的那麼鷹派。」

利率還能升多少？

專家目前認為，日銀可能在12月左右再次升息。
道富的Loo表示，他預期日銀總裁植田和男將強調，未來每一次政策會議都仍然「有可能升息」。他說：「如今爭論的已經不是日銀是否升息，而是利率最終會升到多高。」
日銀表示，隨著經濟與物價情勢發展，將持續調升利率。不過，日銀也承認，中東衝突推升油價，可能導致經濟成長放緩。
EFG International經濟學家Sam Jochim表示，隨著潛在通膨率接近2%，利率可能大約每三個月調升一次。他預期，2027年的終點利率、也就是利率可能達到的峰值，將落在1.75%至2%之間。
BOJ並未預測終點利率，而是持續表示將「適當」執行貨幣政策，以讓潛在通膨率穩定在約2%的目標。
穆迪分析(Moody’s Analytics)亞太區經濟主管Stefan Angrick預期，日銀可能在今年底至明年初再度升息，但需求帶動的通膨疲弱，加上實質薪資成長令人失望，將限縮後續的升息幅度。

items.title: 不排除更大幅度或連續升息！日本央行總裁：貨幣政策進入「新階段」
items.title_en: BOJ Governor Says Monetary Policy Has Entered a "New Phase"; Larger or Consecutive Rate Hikes Not Ruled Out
paras: 日本央行(BOJ)今(18)日結束兩天會議，決定把無擔保隔夜拆款利率目標由1%上調1碼至1.25%，為1995年以來最高水準，該決議以7票贊成、2票反對通過，距6月升息僅時隔三個月，是1990年來間隔最短的連續升息。
BOJ總裁植田和男在會後記者會上表示，基礎通膨率逐步接近2%，日本貨幣政策「已進入新階段」，未來升息節奏與幅度將按物價形勢逐次判斷，不設定「每三個月加一次」等固定路徑。若基礎通膨有持續超過2%的風險，不排除更大幅度或連續升息，但終端利率與中性利率目前難精確界定，將在實際緊縮中慢慢校準。
根據BOJ聲明，物價存在向上偏離2%目標的風險，將繼續依經濟、物價與金融情勢調整寬鬆程度，制定政策時重點看中東局勢、AI需求與匯率傳導。
植田和男指出，中東危機已帶動第二輪物價上漲，油價、進口成本與企業轉價壓力均需警惕，避免通膨明顯超標後被迫劇烈緊縮。
8月數據呈「表面放緩、底層仍緊」。根據日本總務省公布的CPI數據，8月年增率1.9%，剔除鮮食核心CPI年增1.7%、低於7月1.8%，剔除鮮食與能源的核心指標漲1.9%，而政府能源等補貼壓低8月CPI約0.62個百分點。同期，企業物價指數年增7.6%，有色金屬、資通設備、石油煤炭分別大漲，日元計價進口物價年增24.8%，顯示上游成本正往終端傳導。
2張反對票也反映BOJ內部分歧。淺田統一郎認為，核心通膨率仍低於2%，經濟尚不足以支持再度升息；佐藤綾野主張觀察6月升息效果，不急於9月行動。兩人反對及植田「未給下次明確時間表」的事實，削弱市場對BOJ快速連續升息的預期。
金融市場呈「買預期、賣事實」。BOJ決議出爐後，日元兌美元一度貶破157，日本10年期國債殖利率回落，日經225收漲約1.4%。通常，升息會支撐本國貨幣與長債利率，但本次因反對票、缺乏更鷹前瞻，加上美債與Fed升息預期壓住美日利差，日元與日債未獲明顯提振。
分析人士指出，後續焦點轉向今年內BOJ是否再次升息、企業夏季獎金與2027年春鬥薪情能否讓基礎通膨穩住2%；若油價、日元貶值與批發物價繼續向上，BOJ即便內部分歧，仍可能維持每季度評估、漸進推高政策利率。
paras_en: The Bank of Japan (BOJ) concluded its two‑day meeting today (the 18th), raising the uncollateralised overnight call rate target from 1.0% to 1.25% – a 0.25‑percentage‑point increase and the highest level since 1995. The decision passed 7‑to‑2, marking the shortest interval between consecutive hikes since 1990, just three months after the June increase.

BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda told reporters after the meeting that the underlying inflation rate is gradually approaching 2% and that Japan’s monetary policy "has entered a new phase." Future rate‑hike timing and magnitude will be judged case‑by‑case based on price developments, with no preset path such as "every three months." If the core inflation risk of staying above 2% persists, larger or back‑to‑back hikes are not ruled out, although the terminal and neutral rates are currently hard to pin down and will be calibrated gradually as tightening proceeds.

According to the BOJ statement, price pressures pose a risk of deviating upward from the 2% target, and the bank will continue to adjust the degree of easing in line with economic, price and financial conditions, paying particular attention to the Middle‑East situation, AI demand and exchange‑rate transmission when formulating policy.

Ueda noted that the Middle‑East crisis has sparked a second round of price increases, with oil prices, import costs and corporate pass‑through pressures all requiring vigilance to avoid a scenario where inflation clearly overshoots the target and forces a sharp tightening.

August data showed a "surface slowdown but underlying tightness." Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications CPI data showed an annual increase of 1.9% in August, with core CPI (excluding fresh food) up 1.7% year‑on‑year, down from 1.8% in July. Core CPI excluding fresh food and energy rose 1.9%, while government energy subsidies trimmed the August CPI by about 0.62 percentage points. In the same period, the corporate goods price index rose 7.6% year‑on‑year, with large jumps in non‑ferrous metals, ICT equipment and oil‑coal; import prices priced in yen surged 24.8% year‑on‑year, indicating upstream cost pressures are passing through to the end‑user.

The two dissenting votes also reflected internal divisions at the BOJ. Ichiro Asada argued that core inflation remains below 2% and the economy is not strong enough to support another hike; Ayano Sato advocated waiting to see the effect of the June hike and said there was no rush to act in September. Their opposition, together with Ueda’s lack of a clear timetable for the next move, weakened market expectations of rapid consecutive hikes.

Financial markets displayed a "buy the expectation, sell the fact" pattern. After the BOJ decision, the yen briefly fell past ¥157 per dollar, 10‑year Japanese government bond yields retreated, and the Nikkei 225 rose about 1.4%. Typically, a rate hike supports the domestic currency and long‑term bond yields, but this time the dissenting votes, the absence of a more hawkish outlook, and U.S. Treasury and Fed rate‑hike expectations compressing the yen‑U.S. yield spread kept the yen and JGBs from receiving a clear boost.

Analysts said the next focus will be whether the BOJ will hike again within the year, corporate summer bonuses and whether 2027 spring‑time wage negotiations can keep core inflation anchored at 2%. If oil prices, yen depreciation and wholesale prices keep rising, the BOJ may still move forward with quarterly assessments and incremental policy‑rate increases despite internal disagreements.

items.title: 「川習會」前夕人民幣強勢突破6.70關卡 創逾4年新高
items.title_en: Ahead of the ‘Xi‑Trump Meeting’, the RMB Breaks Through the 6.70 Barrier, Reaching a Four‑Year High
paras: 在美中元首即將會面及美國聯準會宣布升息的背景下，在岸與離岸人民幣對美元匯率周五(18日)雙雙升破 6.70 關卡，創下逾4年來新高。
離岸人民幣對美元周五亞市盤中最高升至 6.6935 至 6.6953，在岸人民幣即期匯率升破 6.70 關卡，觸及 6.6954 至 6.6975。中國人民銀行將人民幣對美元中間價設為 6.7521，連續第八個交易日上調，創近兩年最長連升紀錄，釋放明確的穩匯率訊號。今年以來，在岸與離岸人民幣對美元累計升值均已超過 4%。
在國際市場方面，美國聯準會剛決議升息一碼至 4%，點陣圖顯示年內可能再升息，帶動美元指數一度衝高。然而，儘管中國 8 月新增貸款遠低於預期、信用需求偏弱，人民幣依然展現抗跌韌性。
市場分析指出，6.70 為重要技術與心理關卡。人行引導匯率偏強，有助於穩定資金預期並緩解資本外流壓力。
此外，中國國家主席習近平預計於 9 月 24 日與美國總統川普會面，分析認為北京在峰會前容許人民幣升值，能降低美方對弱勢匯率的指控，釋放談判善意。
針對本輪升值行情，東方金誠首席宏觀分析師王青指出，走強主因包含聯準會升息效應釋放後美元指數回落，以及中間價偏強調整。王青表示，中國出口持續高增長與經濟穩中有進為匯率築牢基本面。在「宏觀審慎+微觀監管」框架下，不必過度高估升息衝擊，短期內人民幣預計將維持穩中偏強格局。
另一方面，華福證券首席經濟學家管濤則提醒市場應理性看待升值。管濤表示，雖然短期利多因素占優，但升值的宏觀緊縮效應可能干擾市場情緒。長期來看，「雙向波動」將是常態，不宜將升值過度解讀為資產重估，不宜對匯率做過多的價值判斷。
paras_en: Against the backdrop of an upcoming meeting between the U.S. and Chinese heads of state and the Federal Reserve’s rate‑hike announcement, both on‑shore and off‑shore RMB‑USD rates on Friday the 18th surged past the 6.70 mark, setting a new high not seen in over four years.

The offshore RMB rose to a peak of 6.6935‑6.6953 against the dollar during Friday’s Asian session, while the on‑shore spot rate broke the 6.70 barrier, reaching 6.6954‑6.6975. The People’s Bank of China set the RMB‑USD central parity at 6.7521, marking the eighth consecutive trading day of an upward adjustment and the longest streak in nearly two years, sending a clear signal of rate stability. Since the start of the year, both on‑shore and offshore RMB have appreciated by more than 4% against the dollar.

In international markets, the Fed just voted to raise rates by one basis point to 4%, and the dot‑plot suggests another hike could come later this year, briefly pushing the U.S. dollar index higher. Nevertheless, despite August’s new‑loan growth falling well short of expectations and credit demand remaining weak, the RMB has shown resilience against declines.
Analysts note that 6.70 is a key technical and psychological level. The PBOC’s guidance toward a stronger exchange rate helps stabilize funding expectations and eases pressure from capital outflows.

Moreover, Chinese President Xi Jinping is slated to meet U.S. President Donald Trump on September 24. Analysts believe that allowing the RMB to appreciate before the summit can reduce U.S. accusations of a weak currency and signal goodwill in the negotiations.

Commenting on the recent appreciation, Wang Qing, chief macro analyst at Dongfang Jincheng, said the main drivers are the Fed‑rate‑hike effect that has pulled the dollar index back and the relatively strong central parity adjustment. Wang added that China’s continued strong export growth and a stable‑yet‑improving economy provide a solid fundamentals foundation for the currency. Under a “macro‑prudent plus micro‑regulation” framework, the rate‑hike impact should not be over‑estimated, and the RMB is expected to remain stable‑to‑strong in the short term.

On the other hand, Guan Tao, chief economist at Huafu Securities, cautioned that the market should view the appreciation rationally. Guan said that although short‑term bullish factors dominate, the macro‑tightening effect of an appreciating currency could affect market sentiment. In the long run, “two‑way volatility” will be the norm, and the appreciation should not be over‑interpreted as an asset revaluation nor should the exchange rate be subject to excessive value judgments.

items.title: 【遠東商銀】英國利率不變，英鎊回升乏力

美國8月零售銷售強勁及進口價格飆升，並據美國聯邦準備理事會(FED)如預期升息25個基點，同時預計12月前至少再加息一次及明年維持利率不變，而且利率期貨市場顯示，FED年底前再升息25個基點的機率約90%，激勵美元大漲，但聚焦週五日本央行(BOJ)決議，普遍預計上調利率至三十一年最高1.25%及釋放繼續推高借貸成本訊號，並據週四日本內閣官房長官木原稔表示繼續通過與美國保持密切溝通，努力維持日圓匯率平穩波動，而且日本首相高市早苗改組內閣，留任多名核心閣員以便金融市場動盪時鞏固政治支持，推動其標誌性支出計畫，其中留任財政大臣片山皋月確保對日本匯率政策的連續性，片山皋月則稱堅決應對匯率過度波動，同時留任支持再通貨膨脹政策的城內實為經濟財政大臣，但城內實表示不會實施無節制財政擴張，提供日圓支撐，美元兌日圓自156.31高點走低。

隨後美國商務部公布8月房屋開工跌2.6%至經季節調整年率為127.5萬戶及建築許可減2.7%至年率達139.4萬戶均遜於預期，打擊美元兌日圓至155.32低點，但美國上周初請失業金人數意外降至19.6萬人及費城聯邦儲備銀行9月製造業指數為正37.8優於預估值，而且8月全美房地產經紀人協會(NAR)成屋待完成銷售指數升0.9%至71.2，扶助美元兌日圓反彈。今日市場關注BOJ會議決議及BOJ總裁植田和男會後新聞發布會是否就未來政策走向發出鷹派信號。預估今日美元兌日圓支撐於155.40-60，阻力於156.50-70。
◆EUR/USD
美國料進一步升息推升美元，但昨日紐西蘭公布第二季國內生產總值(GDP)分別較前季與上年同期增長0.2%及2.6%優於預期，料緩解紐西蘭央行(RBNZ)的擔憂，而且國際貨幣基金組織(IMF)認為今年通貨膨脹率保持較高水平及質疑金融環境是否足夠緊縮，澳洲央行(RBA)可能要再加息，緩和澳幣和紐元跌勢，帶動歐元兌美元脫離1.1450低點。

隨著德國機械設備製造聯合會(VDMA)預計今年該行業連續第四年萎縮，下調對該行業表現持平的預測，但明年應可轉折，並據歐洲央行(ECB)管理委員會委員雷恩稱，歐元區未出現明確第二輪通貨膨脹效應，ECB有可行工具確保貨幣政策順利傳導，而且歐元區8月消費者物價調和指數(HICP)較去年同期降至3.2%，但如預期較前月漲0.4%，提振歐元兌美元至1.1497高點。預估今日歐元兌美元阻力於1.1480-1.150，支撐於1.1400-20。
◆GBP/USD

週四英國央行(BOE)貨幣政策委員會(MPC)再次以6比3的投票結果維持利率在3.75%不變，同時將暫停向市場出售英國公債，更預測英國通貨膨脹率將在明年初突破4%，BOE總裁貝利則明確警告，若中東衝突長期持續，可能需要收緊貨幣政策，激勵英鎊兌美元反彈至1.3406高點，但FED鷹派加息的前景推升美元，打壓英鎊兌美元下挫\1.3333低點。預估今日英鎊兌美元阻力於1.3360-80，支撐於1.3260-80。

U.S. August retail sales were strong and import prices surged, and the Federal Reserve (Fed) raised rates by 25 basis points as expected. The Fed also signaled at least one more hike before December and a pause next year, while rate‑futures show about a 90% chance of another 25‑bp increase by year‑end, spurring a sharp rise in the dollar. Market focus shifted to Friday’s Bank of Japan (BOJ) decision, with most expecting a rate hike to a 31‑year high of 1.25% and a signal that borrowing costs will stay elevated. On Thursday, Japanese Chief Cabinet Secretary Minoru Kihara said Japan will keep close communication with the United States to maintain stable yen movements. Prime Minister Kishida also reshuffled the cabinet, retaining many key ministers to solidify political support amid market turbulence and to push forward her flagship spending plan. Finance Minister Shunichi Suzuki stayed on to ensure continuity in Japan’s exchange‑rate policy, pledging a firm response to excessive yen volatility. Economy Minister Shunichi Suzuki also remained, supporting the re‑inflation policy, but he said there will be no reckless fiscal expansion, providing support for the yen. The dollar‑yen fell from a high of 156.31.

Later, the U.S. Commerce Department reported that August housing starts dropped 2.6% to a seasonally adjusted annual rate of 1.275 million units and building permits fell 2.7% to an annual rate of 1.394 million, both missing expectations. This pushed the dollar‑yen down to a low of 155.32. However, initial jobless claims unexpectedly fell to 196,000 and the Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia’s September manufacturing index came in at a positive 37.8, beating forecasts. The National Association of Realtors’ August existing‑home‑sales‑to‑pending‑sales index rose 0.9% to 71.2, helping the dollar‑yen rebound. Today’s market will watch the BOJ’s policy decision and whether Governor Kazuo Ueda’s post‑meeting press conference signals a hawkish outlook. The dollar‑yen is expected to find support around 155.40‑155.60 and face resistance near 156.50‑156.70.
EUR/USD

The United States is expected to keep raising rates, which should lift the dollar, but New Zealand yesterday released Q2 GDP figures showing 0.2% growth versus the previous quarter and 2.6% year‑over‑year, both ahead of expectations. This should ease concerns at the Reserve Bank of New Zealand (RBNZ). Meanwhile, the IMF warned that inflation will stay high this year and questioned whether the financial environment is tight enough, suggesting the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) may need another hike, which could soften the recent declines in the Australian and New Zealand dollars and push the euro‑dollar pair away from the 1.1450 low.

Germany’s VDMA now expects the machinery sector to contract for the fourth consecutive year, lowering its outlook to flat performance but seeing a turnaround possible next year. ECB Governing Council member Robert Holzmann said the euro area has not yet shown a clear second‑round inflation effect and that the ECB has tools to ensure smooth policy transmission. August’s harmonised CPI fell to 3.2% year‑on‑year, though it rose 0.4% from the previous month as expected, lifting the euro‑dollar to a high of 1.1497. The euro‑dollar is projected to face resistance at 1.1480‑1.1500 and support at 1.1400‑1.1420.
GBP/USD

On Thursday the Bank of England’s Monetary Policy Committee voted 6‑3 to keep rates at 3.75% and to pause the sale of gilts. It also forecast that UK inflation will break the 4% mark in early next year. BOE Governor Andrew Bailey warned that a prolonged Middle‑East conflict could force tighter policy, which helped the pound rally to a high of 1.3406 against the dollar. However, the Fed’s hawkish outlook lifted the dollar and pushed the pound down to a low of 1.3333. The pound‑dollar pair is expected to face resistance at 1.3360‑1.3380 and support at 1.3260‑1.3280.
